name: Coal India Ltd
about: Coal India Ltd is mainly engaged in mining and production of Coal and also operates Coal washeries. The major consumers of the company are power and steel sectors. Consumers from other sectors include cement, fertilizers, brick kilns
keyPoints:
A Maharatna company 
Coal India was incorporated in 1975 as Coal Mines Authority Ltd after the nationalization of the coal sector.  [1] It is a 'Maharatna' company under the Ministry of Coal, Government of India with headquarters at Kolkata, West Bengal. [2]

pros: Stock is providing a good dividend yield of 7.11%.
Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 48.7%
Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 45.1%
cons: The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 8.33% over past five years.
